title: Auditoria pós-gate da fase 5 — 18 achados medidos, priorizados, cruzados com PhotoPrism/Immich
summary: Audit report cataloging 18 measured, prioritized UX/data findings across classification, duplicates, trips and operations; no changes implemented.
notes: Audit/findings report referencing decision log entries (D-041 to D-069) but making no decisions itself; each finding is explicitly a 'candidate to decision' deferred to the owner. Not ADR/PRD/SPEC despite containing code-line evidence and measured metrics — no accepted decision, no user-facing requirements, no implementation contract.
